en: Matters of such an official nature are only handled in Darnassus.  You must travel there to begin the process of your guild's creation.
The humans are in need of your assistance in their fight against The Forsaken at Arathi Basin.  Go to the Hall of Arms and speak with their representative, Donal Osgood.

Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.$B$BThat fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.
Good day to you.
Our veteran units are leaving the field.  We need more supplies!
A priestess by the name of Laurna Morninglight calls Dolanaar home.  I believe she can be found just north of the Inn.
Step right up and wet your whistle.
Joo may tink this ma walkin stick mon. Dat's jus wat I want joo to tink.

Oh yes, that's right.$B$BSo, here we are invading deep into the upper reaches of Blackrock Spire, against their lord and leader; this was before Drakkisath. Not too smart if you ask me, but our leader, Anthion Harmon, you met him, was always one who loved a challenge.$B$BSurprisingly, everything went according to plan, right up to the point where we were prying Valthalak's spellbook out of his stiff fingers. That's when it all went south.$B$BShould I continue? You look like your eyes are glazing over.
Marduk, gather the box and place it before me!
%s lashes at your collection phial. The green glow encases you. You don't look so hot, pal.
We have heard your requests, and we agree... it is noble in intent. We will purify your waters. Go with our blessing, shaman.
This is the Alterac Valley battlefield.  Currently both sides are at odds.
Polar Bracers.
Wot kin I do fer ye?
My skill at creating potions is inferior to yours. You are ready to speak with Ainethil, just over there. She will understand that you are ready for further instruction.
The Affray is over!
I would like to enter the secret code to receive my Zergling pet.

Looking for some training, eh? I could train you better then anyone in Stormwind but the guard prohibits it. I guess you will have to settle for one of those has beens hanging out around the Barracks or at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town.
There is but one duty that remains...
Where is Tirth's assistant?
The Lich King has brought war against us from the frozen north, and only we of the Argent Dawn stand in his way.
I must... RESIST!
You've become quite the hunter, $n! Not only have you proven your skills, you also bested Daryl, which gets you extra points in my book!$B$BYou're welcome here any time.
Incredible! Amazing! I don't even know what this means!
The West Frostwolf Tower is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will destroy it!
You need to be friendly with the tauren of Thunder Bluff before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.
The Snowfall Graveyard is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will capture it!
Boys and girls - children of all ages - the Darkmoon Faire has arrived!  Huzzah!
I'm ready, $n. Let's find my equipment and get out of here. I think I know where it is.

The end draws nigh! Even as we speak the last of our supplies are being shipped to Silithus and should arrive within a day. Once there I am sure that all we be assembled in quick order, and then we'll be awaiting the ringing of the gong at the gates to Ahn'Qiraj to start the war. I look forward to analyzing whether our preparatory efforts will make a difference.
Salutations.  I am a guardian of entry.  Unless you have the Plates of Uldum already integrated with your disc set, I will not allow for entry into the Uldum compound.
I foresee no complications at this-- Wait! What is this?
The demon is loose!  Quickly we must restrain him!
A worthless $R such as you, $n, has no right to walk these lands!
THIS CANNOT BE!!
Watcher, inform Althea that a dire threat is marshalling against our town.  We must prepare!
Okay, let's get out of here quick quick! Try and keep up. I'm going to make a break for it.
Your Horde is nothing to the Kolkar!
I'll follow you back to the camp. If you speak with my assistant, Hornizz, he'll have your payment.

Regret. It is all I have now. One bad decision resulting in several horrible outcomes. If only I had waited for those orders. Maybe they would have detailed the horrors that awaited us in those cursed lands! Maybe they were to redirect us to another detail? Ultimately, it was my fault. All of it was my fault.
Me, train you? Come on--we both know I can't. It's this teaching, you see. My own skills suffer. You want training, go to Doctor Herbert Halsey, a Forsaken in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.
What kinda fightin' was that? I should kick all of ya worthless hides off the team and out of the guard!
Get to work, you lubbers!
That's our treasure, you lubber!
Ye'll surely find Maxan Anvol tossin' back a few in the Thunderbrew Distillery.  Why don't ye go have yerself a pint and see if he'll teach ye something new.
We have a medium store of supplies for rebuilding, but we still need a lot more before Frostwolf Keep can be fully repaired.
This spirit hovers over its fallen body.  Its ghostly eyes pierce through you as it gazes beyond...
Beware!  A $n is upon us!
Why did I have to get stuck with this repulsive, feeble excuse for a warlock?
%s reaches out towards Captain Beltis as she falls.
I can teach you the finer points of Tiger Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
